title: "Model Persistence — Decision Tree"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This example demonstrates saving and loading a trained decision tree model using `saveRDS` / `readRDS` with the `aoclda` package.

```{r library}
library(aoclda)
```

## Train

```{r train}
set.seed(42)
X_train <- matrix(rnorm(800), nrow = 200, ncol = 4)
y_train <- sample(0:2, 200, replace = TRUE)

tree <- decision_tree$new(max_depth = 5, criterion = "gini")
tree$fit(X_train, y_train)
```

## Predict Before Save

```{r before}
X_test <- matrix(rnorm(40), nrow = 10, ncol = 4)
predictions_before <- tree$predict(X_test)
cat(sprintf("Predictions before save: %s\n", paste(predictions_before, collapse = " ")))
```

## Save and Load

```{r persistence}
model_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
save_model(tree, model_path)
rm(tree)

tree_loaded <- load_model(model_path)
tree_loaded$print_model_versions()
```

## Predict After Load

```{r after}
predictions_after <- tree_loaded$predict(X_test)
cat(sprintf("Predictions after load: %s\n", paste(predictions_after, collapse = " ")))

cat(sprintf(
    "\nPredictions match: %s\n",
    identical(as.integer(predictions_before), as.integer(predictions_after))
))

file.remove(model_path)
```
